criterion: A test pins that a record from another repository is not parsed
summary: tests.test_journal_contract.JournalRepositoryReadTests adds three tests. test_a_record_from_another_repository_is_never_parsed patches agent_harness.journal.json.loads and asserts it is called exactly twice for a journal holding two records per repository across two repositories - the contract is about work not done, so it is asserted on the parser rather than on the records returned. test_a_repository_named_only_inside_another_field_is_not_returned pins that the substring is only a prefilter: the first version of this test put the marker in a string field, where render escapes its quotes so the prefilter already rejected it and the parsed check did no work - the mutation audit reported that guard UNCOVERED, and the test was rewritten to use a nested object, whose keys render unescaped. test_a_path_needing_json_escaping_still_matches_its_own_records pins that the marker is built with json.dumps, so a Windows path with escaped separators matches its own records. Four guards declared in scripts/mutation_audit.py; audit output: '4 of 4 guards pinned by their named test; 0 declared uncovered'.
